title: Snickers Slice
description: A simple traybake made by melting Snickers bars, adding eggs and flour to create a peanut-caramel sponge — who said baking was difficult?
steps: Preheat the oven to 195°C/175°C fan. Line a 25cm square baking tray with greaseproof paper.
Break seven of the Snickers bars into a heatproof bowl and melt in the microwave, stirring every 20 seconds.
Once fully melted, whisk to get rid of lumps. Add the eggs, sift in the flour and beat until fully combined.
Pour into the tin and bake for 30 minutes, or until spongy to the touch.
Allow to cool in the tin. Before slicing, decorate with the remaining Snickers bar chopped into chunks.
notes: Makes 18 pieces. Per piece estimate. Also works with Mars or Boost bars.
